notes.title: Obscurity State: demo update and Ukrainian Games Fest 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Obscurity State Demo is Live – Ukrainian Games Fest 2025[/h1][p]
[/p][p]We just launched the update for a [b]demo[/b] at Ukrainian Games Festival – huge thanks for jumping in, sharing feedback, testing volume settings (especially mic glitches).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517009/b9967ea62d02ef6d9b5bec396506070e40c01320.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Want more? Invite friends, play the demo together, and hit Wishlist for the main game.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]What’s New in This Version[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Massive refactor & polish pass  [/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes across the board  [/p][/*][*][p]New mic configuration slider  [/p][/*][*][p]Added missing localizations  [/p][/*][*][p]Friend invites: both in-game lobby and Steam overlay  [/p][/*][*][p]“Foot kick” NPC attack  [/p][/*][*][p]NPC updates (especially the child NPC logic)  [/p][/*][*][p]Camera, aim, animation stability fixes  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed voice volume balance between players  [/p][/*][*][p]Fewer entity spawn glitches (improved pool manager)  [/p][/*][*][p]Auto reconnection to voice chat on failure  [/p][/*][*][p]Improved gas, fire, and ignition behavior  [/p][/*][*][p]Endgame fixes (win/lose logic, rewards)  [/p][/*][*][p]Monster loot drops added  [/p][/*][*][p]Global session timer implemented  [/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now heal if unbothered for a while  [/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement smoother (playtest feedback needed)  [/p][/*][*][p]Voice tuning for other players improved  [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Stay tuned – more updates coming soon.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo is Live – Enter the Obscurity State Now
notes.content:
[h1]🕯 Demo is now LIVE – Welcome to the Obscurity State[/h1]

Hello survivors 👋
We're thrilled to announce that the demo version of Obscurity State is now available on Steam! It’s your first chance to explore the cursed city, hear your teammates panic, and decide: will you help them… or leave them behind?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517009/a4cf44d52a629371c03350424158e9374b9617a4.jpg[/img]
[h2]🔹 What’s in the demo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Online co-op with friends or strangers
[*] One intense mission to retrieve a mysterious artifact
[*] Voice chat that actually matters — monsters listen
[*] Evacuation system where not everyone makes it back
[/list]

[h2]🔸 What’s coming next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Frequent updates based on your feedback
[*] More content, improved stability, and feature polish
[*] Full game in the works – Wishlist it now to stay in the loop!
[/list]

💬 Let us know your thoughts, report bugs, or share your best (and worst) survival stories in the community hub.

Thanks for joining us at this early stage.
We’re building Obscurity State with you — and we hope you survive long enough to see what’s next 🖤

— The Dev Team
